text: Before any feature or model gets built, V1 needs a hard written line around what it actually ships, and what it honestly doesn't.
V1 ships exactly three things: a weekly risk score, a plain-language reason it was flagged, and a defined audience, Tom Bellamy's team first, Dana Okafor's team second.
What's explicitly deferred, not dropped: automated retention outreach triggered by the score, and any fix to the actual product problems that cause churn.
Think of it like a smoke detector. It notices the smoke and says so loudly. It doesn't fight the fire itself, and it doesn't rebuild the kitchen afterward.
Next: choosing the real stack, SQL Server, Python, and Azure ML, behind this score.
